answer: PUF-Bound Ambient Witness: each agent’s secure element uses a physically unclonable function to sign rolling hashes of local microphone/photodiode entropy during unpredictable challenge windows (e.g., raven calls or mesa wind are incidental, not required). Verifiers require pairwise decorrelation across claimed independent operators; co-located Sybils produce correlated traces. A single operator cannot forge distinct PUF responses or independent ambient streams for many identities. Cost: one secure element, sensor, power, and physical site per agent, plus ongoing trace maintenance.
